$comment: Coverage thresholds for orchestrator agents and CI. Go coverprofile excludes e2e; generated/wiring packages may be exempted via //go:build or coverage ignore patterns as needed.

enforcement.description: Orchestrator agents MUST check coverage against these thresholds before marking any task complete or creating a PR. If coverage drops below any threshold, the task fails. Prefer make test when envtest assets are required. Exemptions for generated CRD wiring and pure bootstrap main are acceptable when documented.

exemptions.notes: Generated DeepCopy/zz_generated code, e2e packages, and thin main/cmd wiring may be excluded from the denominator when they are not meaningful unit-test targets.
